elements.element: No non-compete restriction imposed on Customer
elements.evidence: § 12.4 ("Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor") is deleted in full

elements.element: No field-of-use / territory restriction on Customer
elements.evidence: Remaining § 12.3: "Nothing restricts Customer from ... conducting business in any field or territory."

elements.element: Customer confirmed to have given no exclusivity/non-compete commitment (no contradictory covenant remains)
elements.evidence: "Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete ... commitment." with § 12.4 removed

elements.element: Any restriction limited to a named competing product
elements.evidence: No competing-product restriction remains after deletion of § 12.4; limit vacuously satisfied

elements.element: Restriction operative during the term only
elements.evidence: The 'and for twenty-four months thereafter' tail is removed with § 12.4
"During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter" no longer appears in the redline
§ 12.3 preserves freedom to develop "any product or service"; no restriction to carve out from
§ 12.3 preserves freedom "acquiring ... any product or service"

reasons: The locked preferred level is achieved: the only operative non-compete on Customer (§ 12.4) is removed, leaving § 12.3's express confirmation that no non-compete, exclusivity or field/territory restriction applies.

Deletion of the whole of § 12.4 is minimal here because the entire paragraph consists solely of the offending restriction; no narrower edit (operator, number or short phrase) could reach the preferred position of no restriction at all, and no new words were added.
No unrelated commercial term is disturbed: § 12.3 was left untouched, and removing § 12.4 cures rather than creates a contradiction, leaving no dangling cross-reference or undefined term.
The fallback limits are vacuously satisfied because the conditioning restriction is demonstrably absent; the redline sits above, not at, the fallback.
